name: cliff_linear_vesting_burn_fdv
question_template: A fictional token has a maximum supply of {MAX_SUPPLY} tokens, of which {CIRC_PCT} percent is circulating at the start of month 1. Vesting works in whole months: at the start of month {CLIFF} a cliff tranche equal to {CLIFF_PCT} percent of maximum supply unlocks into circulation, and at the start of every later month through month 12 a further {LINEAR_PCT} percent of maximum supply unlocks. At the end of month {BURN_MONTH}, after any unlock scheduled for that month, the protocol burns {BURN_PCT} percent of the tokens circulating at that moment; burned tokens are permanently removed from both circulating supply and maximum supply. No other supply changes occur and the price stays at {PRICE} USD per token. What is the fully diluted valuation in USD at the end of month 12, defined as price times the remaining maximum supply?

slots.description: Circulating supply at the end of the burn month immediately before the burn.
Circulating supply at the end of month 12 after all unlocks and the burn.

program:
def solve():
    max_supply = Q(P["MAX_SUPPLY"])
    circ0 = max_supply * Q(P["CIRC_PCT"]) / 100
    cliff = P["CLIFF"]
    cliff_tranche = max_supply * Q(P["CLIFF_PCT"]) / 100
    linear_tranche = max_supply * Q(P["LINEAR_PCT"]) / 100
    burn_month = P["BURN_MONTH"]
    burn_ratio = Q(P["BURN_PCT"]) / 100
    price = Q(P["PRICE"])

    def unlocked_by(month):
        if month < cliff:
            return Q(0)
        linear_count = month - cliff
        return cliff_tranche + linear_tranche * linear_count

    circ_before_burn = circ0 + unlocked_by(burn_month)
    burned = circ_before_burn * burn_ratio
    circ_end = circ0 + unlocked_by(12) - burned
    remaining_max = max_supply - burned
    fdv = price * remaining_max
    return {
        "final": fdv,
        "circ_before_burn": circ_before_burn,
        "burned_tokens": burned,
        "circ_end_month_12": circ_end,
    }
